Pancakes from scratch

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 cups Flour

  • 3 1/2 teaspoons Baking Powder

  • 1 Tablespoon Sugar

  • 1 Teaspoon Salt

  • 1 1/4 Cups Milk

  • 1 Large Egg

  • 3 Tablespoons of melted (room temp) Butter

  • Fresh fruit as desired

Directions!

Mix all the dry ingredients together, then make a "well" in the middle (just move everything away from the center, making, well... a well.). Add the Egg, mixing in Milk slowly. Add fruit, gently, as desired (unless bananas or other soft fruit - add those to the top while griddling).

Fire up skillet/griddle, grease lightly and ladle size as desired.

Bonus syrup from scratch:

  • 1 Cup (packed) Brown sugar

  • "scant 1/2 Cup" (minus 1~2 Tablespoons) Water

  • Dollop of honey, to taste (optional)

Place brown sugar in sauce pan. Pour in water (and honey, if desired), set heat on high and bring to a roiling boil. Stirring is unnecessary unless there are hard clumps not dissolving. Let boil for 30~60 seconds, then tun off heat. When boiling stops completely, remove from burner and let thicken. Serve atop pancakes.

Cook bacon and eggs aside. Serve and eat!
